bestBets.overview: SHINY LOVE is racing in consistent form having been placed in three starts since Emerald win. This not a difficult affair and she can return to winners stall. SEERESS was bit disappointing at Ipswich last start but she had raced in town prior and in what looks an easier affair cannot leave her out. TWIN TURBO was beaten less than 2 lengths at massive odds at Townsville last start. That form good enough to feature while EAGLE WARRIOR has been working home well enough in recent races and he can sneak a place.

raceTips.comment: SHINY LOVE continues to race well. She was strong through the line last time when dropping back in journey and the rise to 1800m here looks ideal. EAGLE WARRIOR went back to last off the wide gate last time and hit the strongly late. He gets a senior rider aboard this time and back in grade, he can certainly figure. TWIN TURBO was always wide over the mile two runs back and worked home strongly late last time when stepping out to 2000m. He looks nicely placed in the smaller field. SEERESS had no luck at all last start at Ipswich. She’s fit and should find this easier than what she’s been contesting.

bestBets.overview: DWAYNE only just missed in a driving finish at Emerald last start. Only needs to find that form and he will be in the finish again. INTREPID LAD sowed good speed before being claimed late at Rockhampoton last start. If he can find the front and control this race he will take catching from the corner. ELITE GATHERING comes to Queensland in new stable. She won at Port Augusta last start and this is not a difficult affair while HOU LONG GWAI was not disgraced at Rockhampton last start and he can sneak a first four spot.

raceTips.comment: INTREPID LAD was just collared late last start when leading over the mile. Freshened, the winkers go on and the low draw will see him afforded every chance. MARAVILLAS is on the quick back up after competing at Bowen on Saturday, where he didn’t have the best of luck. The regally bred gelding looks well placed stepping out to this trip and gets a senior rider back in the saddle. MY SPY strips fitter for the two runs back, he gets the inside draw and can improve. HOU LONG GWAI was a winner at Rockhampton last month but has just struggled in stronger company at his past two. He draws to get the right run and will be in it for a long way.

bestBets.overview: Not a difficult maiden on exposed form. THE HOUSE is a debutant from the Kevin Miller stable. He was not disgraced when beaten less than 2 lengths in his recent trial and if any support must follow. CINCHICATED chased home well enough when just missed at Gladstone last start. This looks no harder and she can sneak a place again. JONKER ROCKET did enough when close-up in his trial at Rockhampton. Awkward draw but must respect while DAVOS is another first start who has shown enough in  trials and would not leave out.

raceTips.comment: CINCHICATED was beaten only narrowly last start at Gladstone. She’s fit and will take catching off the low draw. JONKER ROCKET makes his debut. Strong through the line in a recent 1000m Rockhampton trial, he looks ready to go and the 1100m kick off will suit. THE HOUSE has been given the one public trial and was strong through the line as he finished just in behind the winner. He looked to do everything right and the 1100m looks ideal. DAVOS is also on debut. He’s been readied for this with two recent trials and gets the advantage of the inside draw.

bestBets.overview: BALKAN MELODY held her ground for tough placing beaten less than a length at Rockhampton last start. This looks no harder and she can get away with this. MO SPIRIT was a little one paced here last start but still not disgraced. If he can hold that form he should be right in the mix. HOT LUCI has been competitive when just out of placings in last couple. Drawn touch awkwardly but can sneak a place while SAILING SOLO was poor last start but he had been placed in two prior startts and would not leave out of exotics.

raceTips.comment: BALKAN MELODY hasn’t been far away in recent runs and looks to have found a winnable race. Hard fit, the 1300m suits and gate five should see her afforded every chance. MANOFTHELAND has just found them too sharp over the 1000m. The rise in trip looks ideal and I think we’ll see a much improved performance from him. BESTOV was beaten only a length at Rockhampton two runs back but failed to fire when dropping back in trip at Emerald. On the quick back up, she can improve. SAILING SOLO was always wide and exposed last start at Rockhampton and felt the pinch late. He’d been placed in his two runs prior and can bounce back.

bestBets.overview: FIVE STAR KING has the speed to cross and lead these. He has been in front for a long way in recent races and gets chance to run them off their hooves in this field. BREECHES is an other that should make her own luck sitting on the pace. Expect she will be competitive for a long way. MAKING HISTORY has been a bit disapponting in recent starts but he had some support at Rockhampton last start and dont want to leave out of exotics while ME TIME resumes from a long spell. Yet to be placed fresh but this not a difficult affair.

raceTips.comment: FIVE STAR KING has been placed in all three runs for the new stable but he did weaken late last time when stepping out to 1300m. Freshened, the drop back in trip will suit and the blinkers go on. BREECHES is racing well but was just run down late last start after leading at Townsville. She draws well and if she can find cover early, she’ll be strong late. ARANCIA just needed the run when resuming at Townsville and she was taken out of contention by another runner last start at Bowen. At peak fitness and with the advantage of the inside draw, she can make her presence felt. MELO MELO KAVA looks well placed with the slight drop back in grade. She’s hard fit and must be included.

bestBets.overview: DETERMINATION won a couople in a row at this track earlier this prep before being out-classed in town last start. He gets back in a winnable race. LUCKY LASS won her four starts back then has backed that up with three straight placings. Only needs to produce a similar run to be right in the mix again. THEE CREEK started favourite and chased home strongly to win at Townsville last start. He can go on with it here while HOT DIGITY BOOM looked in need of the run when made good late ground first-up. He will be better from that outing.

raceTips.comment: HOT DIGGITY BOOM got a long way back and found the line well without threatening when resuming for the new yard. The former Victorian boasts solid formlines and with the added fitness, he’ll be hard to beat. THE EXTREME CAT is a recent addition to the Lachie Manzelmann stable. He races well fresh, the 1100m suits and from the wide gate he’ll get back and finish off strongly. DETERMINATION made it back to back wins here but pulled up making respiratory noises following his latest run at Eagle Farm. With the inside draw, he can bounce back. LUCKY LASS is hard fit and racing well. She loves it here at Mackay and will be doing her best work late.
